tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (app canvas). Off-white with a slight blue bias.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, rows, inputs — the default raised plane on bg.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: table headers, input wells, hover rows, skeletons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows and sections.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips, filter button). At least 3.5:1 on surface, 3:1 on surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on bg, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Deep blue brand: primary buttons, active nav, links, focus of the brand.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, active nav pill, info banners background.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring (2px, offset 2px) on every surface.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Income amounts, goals reached, favourable change — always with a + sign or icon.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of positive badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Upcoming bills, budget nearing limit — always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, overspend, negative balances, destructive actions. Expense amounts use negative.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and banners.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Expense amounts and negative values. Always with a true minus sign (−). Zero is never negative: it stays ink with no sign.

tokens.name: transfer
tokens.usage: Transfers between own accounts — neither income nor expense.

tokens.name: transfer-soft
tokens.usage: Background of transfer badges.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (primary measure).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3: comparison or previous period. Always drawn dashed or hatched so it is told apart by pattern, not hue.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: hero
tokens.usage: The blue balance card on Home and account pages. Solid, never a gradient.

tokens.name: on-hero
tokens.usage: Text and icons on hero. 10:1.

tokens.name: on-hero-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and captions on hero. 6.8:1.

tokens.name: hero-deco
tokens.usage: Decorative circles and arcs inside the hero card. Never behind text that needs reading.

tokens.name: cat-orange
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Food, eating out). On cat-orange-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-orange-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Food, eating out).

tokens.name: cat-teal
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Transport, travel). On cat-teal-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-teal-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Transport, travel).

tokens.name: cat-pink
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Family, gifts, giving, celebrations). On cat-pink-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-pink-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Family, gifts, giving, celebrations).

tokens.name: cat-gold
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Electricity, fuel, bills). On cat-gold-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Electricity, fuel, bills).

tokens.name: cat-green
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Health, income categories). On cat-green-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-green-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Health, income categories).

tokens.name: cat-purple
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Rent, home, household). On cat-purple-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-purple-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Rent, home, household).

tokens.name: cat-sky
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Data, airtime, subscriptions, school fees). On cat-sky-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-sky-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Data, airtime, subscriptions, school fees).

tokens.name: cat-slate
tokens.usage: Category icon colour (Bank charges, loans, other). On cat-slate-soft: 4.4:1 or more.

tokens.name: cat-slate-soft
tokens.usage: Category tile background (Bank charges, loans, other).

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one headline balance (hero card) and the keypad amount. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount-lg
styles.usage: Summary cards and the amount input.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Transaction rows and list values. Right-aligned, tabular.

styles.name: amount-sm
styles.usage: Secondary amounts under progress bars and in tables.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Record what you spend, even offline.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines in rows and cards, in ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, button text (sm), tab labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Date group headers in feeds. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between tight items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical), card gap on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Section gap inside a card.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on tablets and desktop; card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of empty states, large separations.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, category tiles, keypad keys, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The hero balance card and the floating navigation.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons (pill), avatars, progress tracks, the add button.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards on bg (light uses border + this; dark relies on surface lightness).

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, bottom sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and inputs on desktop tables and filters.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions on phones; amount input.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on touch screens, even when the visual is smaller.

tokens.name: nav-bottom
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom navigation height (plus safe area).

tokens.name: nav-rail
tokens.usage: Tablet navigation rail width.

tokens.name: nav-sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: bp-medium
tokens.usage: From here: navigation rail, two-column cards, dialogs instead of full-screen forms.

tokens.name: bp-expanded
tokens.usage: From here: list + detail side by side; tables replace transaction cards.

tokens.name: bp-large
tokens.usage: From here: persistent sidebar, three-column dashboards.

tokens.name: bp-xlarge
tokens.usage: From here: extra analysis column; content stays capped, never stretched.

tokens.name: width-form
tokens.usage: Forms and single-task flows (add expense, create budget).

tokens.name: width-reading
tokens.usage: Help, legal, explanations.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Default page content area.

tokens.name: width-wide
tokens.usage: Dashboards and reports on very large screens.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press, hover, toggle feedback.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Sheets, toasts, tab changes.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Number count-ups and chart transitions (skipped under reduced motion).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most transitions. Animate transform and opacity only.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Presses, the add button, keypad keys, tiles being chosen: a small overshoot that feels alive.
